note: Simple Additive Weighting profiles. Weights must sum to 1. Edit here, not in code; the server refuses to start with an invalid file. 'default' reproduces the approved 10 Nov 2026 Top 5 model exactly.

default.rationale: Approved Phase 15I model: interest, travel and budget match the Phase 15B group weights; group fit combines child and group needs.

nature_attractions.rationale: Nature trips are decided by what the place is, how hard it is for this party, and the weather, so nature fit, physical suitability and weather carry 50% together; travel, budget and the rest follow the default model. Proposed 16 Nov 2026; to be confirmed by the project adviser.
